content.short: CrazyFootball is a Web3 fantasy football league where players build teams and compete for prizes.
content.description: CrazyFootball is a fantasy football platform where players build a dream team, stake Football Tokens and compete in gameweeks for prize pools, with tens of thousands of active players. It is built on Solana and runs a CrazyFootball Game mini app inside World App, listed in World's ecosystem directory.
content.meta: CrazyFootball is a Web3 fantasy football league on Solana, with a mini app in World App.
